headers: B) UKH v ZON (4.41 a.m., November ---)
limits: The source contains 183 slots and advertises 184; a missing coordinate is hypothesized inside or at the edge of the visibly four-slot XFVV group.

Boundaries 16 and 17 tie for the least observed-coordinate cost among the five possible insertions in that group. Both mappings and raw readings are retained. Boundary 17 is the display convention only.
The complete first 17 decoded positions remain unedited, including nine unresolved positions and numerical labels. No serial, addressee or office is supplied from grammar.
Ordinary words in the body are explicit lexical repairs. The certificate proves their exact compatibility and price, not unique historical wording.
The inquiry asks whether flying units should leave or remain; it does not establish that either action happened. The missing intercept day stays missing.
The published key is unchanged; no source slot is deleted or reordered. A complete re-encryption witness fills residual masks mechanically and is explicitly nonhistorical.
Earlier period-key recovery and repository work retain their credit. This is source restoration and editorial repair, not a first-decipherment claim.
